profile.headline: Software Engineer at NBCUniversal | Educator  | ERUSD Board Member
profile.summary:
My purpose in life is to create technology that makes a difference in this world. To me, the ultimate goal is not to create a product but to create a change!

Being raised by two Mexican immigrants, I know the true value of a great education by becoming the first in my family to graduate from college.  I decided to join Teach for America in Washington D.C. as a middle school math teacher where I taught math entirely in Spanish to an amazing group of students who came from diverse backgrounds. It gave me the opportunity to notice the positive impact a Latina role model can have on their academic success.

Unfortunately, through this experience, I also saw the lack of Latinos in STEM education.  Because of this, my ultimate drive is continuously striving to increase minority representation in the tech field.  I am always advocating for more students to fall in love with STEM topics whether through math class, robotics or learning coding.  By being featured in the White House Initiative on Educational Excellence for Hispanics Heritage Month Teacher Profile, recognized by Los Angeles Mayor Garcetti as well as in Univision's Puente al Futuro Special for leading a robotics team with my students in East Los Angeles, I was able to increase awareness around this issue. 

Currently, I have learned Ruby on Rails, Javascript, MySQL, Postgres, CSS and HTML to further continue my passion of coding.  I am a recent Facebook F8 Scholar graduate of Dev Bootcamp in San Francisco and I would love to continue my dream of helping more students master Math as a software developer because they are the next generation of mathematicians, developers and leaders.

positions.title: Founding 7th Grade Math Teacher
positions.description:
•	Utilized educational technology such as Classdojo, IXL, Khan Academy, Mangahigh and MasteryConnect to meet my students' needs 
•	Increased number of students mastering SBAC by 25% from the year before
•	96% of 7th grade students (120 students) saw an increase in their national test MAP from Fall 2015 to Fall 2016
•	Responsible for developing and implementing Common Core curriculum for seventh grade Mathematics 
•	Founded and lead the Lego-robotics program for 4th-7th graders
•	Daily analyze data from exit tickets for strategic student groups to prepare for the state exam
•	Attend regular PDs on mastering mathematics teaching
•	Founded the after school robotics lego mindstorms program

positions.title: 7th and 8th Grade Algebra Math Teacher (Oyster Adams Bilingual School)
positions.description:
•	Responsible for developing and implementing Common Core curriculum in Spanish for seventh grade Mathematics and eighth grade Algebra 
•	Served on the schedule committee to develop a schedule for the entire middle school
•	Created all Google docs, Google spreadsheets, and Shutterfly website for all 7th grade team meetings and fundraisers
•	Tutored a group of seventh grade students to perform Advanced on the DC-CAS state exam
•	Coordinated and led the Adams Robotics club of 4th-8th grade students to compete in DCPS Robotics Competition
•	Developed curriculum for 6th-8th grade math support class by incorporating projects and Code.org along educational technology websites
•	Led English camps in Bilbao, Spain and Atenas, Costa Rica with 7th and 8th grade students
•	Led Mathematical workshops for Spanish speaking parents with basic Math skills
•	Led the fundraising events for seventh grade field trips such as camping trip and Spain, raising over $3000

positions.title: Research Assistant, UCSB Political Science with Professor Lorraine McDonnell
positions.description:
•	Responsible for performing a content analysis of the common core state standards (CCSS) mathematics standards
•	Utilized a content analysis software program to code the types of evidence the standards developers used to justify particular topics and learning trajectories
•	Researched how students learned as well as what other countries and states with high standards include in their math standards and classroom practice

volunteerExperiences.description:
Recently participated in Global Teaching Adventures' Volunteer English Camp
program in Thailand, Myanmar and Cambodia.  I also received a 20 Hr TESOL certification from an online TESOL course accredited by TESOL Standards International, an industry leading standards agency that reviews and accredits TESOL programs around the world. During the English Camp program, I acted as Camp Counselor where I completed 130 service hours planning and preparation of lesson plans as well as adapting to a variety of students' age, the level of English, and learning abilities.

Young Alumni Bridge for Teach for America's DC region. We work to form a network of social/professional young alumni in DC area. Founded the 1st Annual Professional Conference where I brought together alums and current TFA students to create a greater networking experience.

projects.title: CoCo: College Counselor
projects.description:
As a parent of a first-generation college student, it can be difficult to understand and navigate the road to college. There are many tests, requirements, and deadlines. CoCo will introduce you into everything you need to know, and help you and your child keep track of everything such as A-G requirements, scholarships, SAT deadlines and waivers. When you sign up on this website, you will receive weekly texts to keep you informed.

Tech Stack: Ruby on Rails 5, Twilio, Google Maps, Google Translate, Ember JS, Nokogiri, Ajax, CSS, HTML, Materialize, PostgreSQL

projects.title: Teacher Treasure Trash
projects.description: Teacher Treasure Trash is a website for teachers who are leaving the classroom or simply needing to get rid of supplies/furniture. It allows one teacher's trash to turn into another teacher's treasure by having teachers post items and be able to search based on category type and location.
